definitions.gloss: frog kick; the breaststroke leg motion
definitions.explanation: The characteristic leg movement of the breaststroke, in which the knees bend and the feet sweep outward and then together, resembling the kick of a frog.

examples.japanese: {蛙足|かえるあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: To swim with a frog kick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ→平泳ぎ：06526_hiraoyogi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蛙足|かえるあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In the breaststroke you use a frog kick.

examples.japanese: {蛙足|かえるあし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: When you time the frog kick right, your body glides forward well.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{蛙|かえる}→蛙：04300_kaeru⟧ (frog) + ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (legs). The leg action of the breaststroke (⟦{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ→平泳ぎ：06526_hiraoyogi⟧), where the feet draw up, sweep out, and snap together like a frog kicking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蛙足|かえるあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧: to swim with a frog kick
- {蛙足|かえるあし}⟦キック→キック：08940_kikku⟧: frog kick

Mainly a swimming term; the motion is also called あおり⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧.
